description: When does FDA marketing exclusivity expire for a drug — the listed Orange Book exclusivity expiration dates for a brand or ingredient, with the earliest and latest across the whole schedule. Ask by drug alone to get everything on file; add from_date/to_date only when you want a window, and anything excluded is counted and dated back to you. Exclusivity codes have program-specific meanings; expiration alone does not guarantee generic approval or launch.

drug.description: Ingredient, trade name, or applicant, e.g. "Jardiance" or "empagliflozin".

from_date.description: Optional window start YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the drug's whole schedule.

to_date.description: Optional window end YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the drug's whole schedule.

name: orange_book_exclusivity_expirations
title: Orange Book Exclusivity Expirations
